provenance.title: Launch HN: Freestyle – Sandboxes for Coding Agents

facts.statement: Freestyle provides sandboxes for coding agents as a cloud platform for managing AI code.
Freestyle's product is built for coding agents that run complex tasks and workflows in Linux virtual machines.
facts.value: coding agents running complex tasks and workflows

facts.statement: The product depends on improvements in AI enabling agents to utilize the full power of a computer sandbox rather than minimal tools, a shift occurring around 2 years before 2026.
facts.value: AI advances allowing full sandbox utilization circa 2024

facts.statement: Freestyle's offering is full Linux virtual machines with systemd init, not sandbox-shaped containers, providing real root access and multi-user isolation.
facts.value: full Linux VMs with systemd init and root access

facts.statement: The product features live forking of running VMs without pausing, cloning full memory state in under 400ms.
They support full Linux + hardware virtualization, eBPF, Fuse, and full networking stack with nested virtualization capabilities.
facts.value: full Linux with hardware virtualization, eBPF, Fuse, networking

facts.statement: Freestyle was publicly launched or announced around April 2026 as indicated by a Hacker News post dated 2026-04-06.
Users can start using Freestyle immediately via a public API to create and run VMs without contacting sales.
Freestyle publishes transparent pricing plans online, including a free forever tier with up to 10 concurrent VMs and a Hobby plan at $50/month.
The launch Hacker News post about Freestyle received 322 points and 158 comments four months before the record retrieval date in August 2026.
The open source repository 'freestyle-sh/Adorable' has 800 stars as of 2026-08-23.
The 'freestyle-sh/Adorable' repository was most recently pushed to on 2026-03-19.
The 'freestyle-sh/Adorable' repository has 16 watchers, 312 forks and 12 open issues as of the last retrieval date.
The GitHub account freestyle-sh is an organization, not a personal account.
Freestyle lists vly.ai, Rork, and Vibeflow as customers or users of its platform.
Freestyle Git backs every agent with branchable filesystems featuring commits, diffs, rollback, and review, accumulating code data per agent.
facts.value: Git-backed filesystems with branch and commit history

facts.statement: There are two cofounders named Ben and Jacob as stated on the Hacker News launch post.

why_this_call.text: Watch — 64/100 meets the 55 a watch needs and is below the 72 a meeting needs, at 100% coverage.
The largest shortfall is D1 Founder–market fit & technical depth at 5/25 (band 0–5).

D5 Path to defensibility: find a named third-party product it works with, or 10 or more human contributors, beside the thing it accumulates. That moves it from 9–12 to 13–15 (+3).
